{{Quote|My mother was a captain in the Grand Army of the Republic. She died in the Battle of T'olan, in the Wuun system&hellip;|Trever Flume|<ref name="TDM" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''soldier''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]] and [[Reproduction/Legends|had two children]], [[Trever Flume|Trever]] and [[Tike Flume]], with a [[Trever Flume's father|doctor]]. During the early phases of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which began in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], she fought in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Military/Legends|armed forces]] against secessionists known as the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Holding the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Captain/Legends|captain]], she [[Death/Legends|died]] fighting in the [[Battle of T'olan]] early in the war.

==Biography==
In the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] waning [[Standard year/Legends|decades]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] called [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]]. She eventually had two sons, [[Tike Flume|Tike]] and [[Trever Flume]], with a [[Trever Flume's father|doctor]].<ref name="TDM" /> The younger of the two, Trever, was born around the year [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission">In ''[[The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission]]'', [[Trever Flume]] tells [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] of his mother's [[Death/Legends|death]] in the [[Battle of T'olan]]. Based upon the time frame of the battle, Kenobi thinks that Flume was about nine [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old by then.</ref> While Flume was growing up, the family was quite happy and inseparable. They went to concerts and played [[Laserball/Legends|laserball]] in their hometown, the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ussa]]. On [[Standard week/Legends|weekends]], they frequented a particular café.<ref name="ATW">''[[The Last of the Jedi: A Tangled Web]]''</ref>

Approximately [[22 BBY/Legends|nine years after Trever's birth]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems's]] secession from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] plunged [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] into the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The woman went to fight the Confederacy with the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]].<ref name="TDM" /> Before she left, she told Trever that it was too dangerous for him to come with her and assured him that she would return safely.<ref name="Underworld">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]''</ref> She [[Death/Legends|died]] early in the conflict, serving as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] at the [[Battle of T'olan]], at a place called [[T'olan]] in the [[Wuun system]].<ref name="TDM" />

Flume did not talk much about his [[Parent/Legends|mother]] after her death. When his father and brother died in a bombing after the [[19 BBY/Legends|end of the war]], he was orphaned.<ref name="TDM" /> He spent months trying to forget all these deaths, consumed by his anger and hurt feelings.<ref name="SW">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]''</ref> He dropped out of school<ref name="ATE">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Against the Empire]]''</ref> to live on the street and allied with the Bellassan [[Black market/Legends|black market]] to keep himself alive. They had him do various jobs in exchange for food and shelter.<ref name="TDM" /> This also conveniently kept him away from his family's stomping grounds in the upscale parts of Ussa.<ref name="ATW" /> He preferred not to be reminded of any of them.<ref name="ROTDS">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Return of the Dark Side]]''</ref> Even so, he did think of them fondly and their deaths lingered in his mind.<ref name="TDM" /><ref name="ATW" /> Remembering what his mother had said to him before leaving, and his father and brother saying similar things before their own deaths, he became deeply averse to people he cared about saying "I'll be back" before doing dangerous things.<ref name="Underworld" />

==Personality and traits==
Trever Flume's mother could get a fierce look in her eye when she was protective of her children.<ref name="ROTDS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trever Flume first mentioned his mother, though she was not named, in the [[2005]] young reader novel ''[[The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission]]'' by [[Jude Watson]].<ref name="TDM" />

Trever Flume said that his mother fought in the Grand Army of the Republic in ''The Desperate Mission'', but he must have been mistaken.<ref name="TDM" /> ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' ([[2012]]) stated that the Grand Army's infantry was exclusively [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]],<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> who were all men and<ref name="Warfare78">According to ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', ''"The [[Military rank/Legends|role]] of [[Clone Corporal|corporal]] was traditionally awarded to the best [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Squad/Legends|squad]], but in an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Cloning/Legends|identical]] [[Gender/Legends|men]], it was often rotated among the [[Clone trooper/Legends|troopers]], and carried no special insignia."''</ref> nigh<ref name="SBES">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]'' stars the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[X1]] and [[X2]], whose [[Falon Grey|genetic template]] was not [[Jango Fett]].</ref> exclusively [[Cloning/Legends|sourced]] from the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. On the other hand, Jedi Generals were considered part of the Grand Army and were not clones, but they significantly outranked the [[Clone Captain|captains]], who were clones. Nonetheless, there were non-clone branches of the Military fighting for the Republic, such as the [[Planetary Security Forces]] or the [[Judicial/Legends|Judicials]].<ref name="Warfare" />

A later book in the series, ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]]'' ([[2006]]), incorrectly stated that she died fighting the [[Galactic Empire]],<ref name="DON">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]]''</ref> which did not exist at the time of her death.<ref>''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Declaration of a New Order|founding]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], immediately before the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. According to ''[[The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission]]'', she [[Death/Legends|died]] "early in the wars."</ref> After that, in ''[[The Last of the Jedi: A Tangled Web]]'' (2006), Trever Flume remembered his mother dying on Bellassa rather than at T'olan.<ref name="ATW" /> These erroneous references to her death lumped her together with her partner and other son,<ref name="ATW" /><ref name="DON" /> whom Imperials did kill on Bellassa according to ''The Desperate Mission'',<ref name="TDM" /> but ''A Tangled Web'' also explicitly mentioned those two dying together independently from her.<ref name="ATW" />
